backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the StudentSathi backend, defining data types and shared functions for feature requests, user profiles, announcements, assignments, study tasks, and conversation history, with role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (primarily LeaveApplicationPage CSS grid layout, responsive breakpoints, and input styling changes) to their affected files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing short human-readable summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key features of each page, component, hook, and config file in the project.
frontend/.release/production-version.txt: Single-value file containing the current production draft version number (73) used by the CI/CD system to determine which build to promote to the live channel.
frontend/.release/README.md: Documents the CI/CD production version management system, explaining how updating production-version.txt promotes a specific draft version to the live channel without rebuilding source code.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the full design token system (colors, borders, charts, sidebar) in both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the StudentSathi React app, setting the page title and mounting the root div with the main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes, wraps the app in ThemeProvider for light/dark mode, and renders the global Toaster notification component.
frontend/src/components/AssignmentChatbo: Floating AI chatbot component for the assignment page supporting multi-language UI, voice input/output, image upload via Tesseract OCR, and downloadable AI-generated assignment content in PDF, Word, or text formats.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Defines the main app layout with a sticky header containing desktop and mobile navigation links, an Outlet for page content, and a footer with attribution.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Butto: A reusable Button primitive with configurable variant and size styles, supporting an asChild prop to clone styles onto a child element.
Exports composable Card layout primitives (Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter) with Tailwind-based styling.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Sheet: A custom slide-in Sheet/drawer component with context-based open state, supporting left/right/top/bottom sides, a trigger, and an overlay backdrop.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Toast: A placeholder Toaster component that renders nothing, intended to be replaced with a full toast notification implementation.
frontend/src/components/StudentSathiAssi: A chat assistant component supporting text, voice (speech recognition), and image (OCR via Tesseract.js) input, with assignment generation and confirmation flows using React Query mutations.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Dai: A markdown note indicating that DailyProgressChart.tsx is working correctly and must not be modified as part of the weekly chart fix.
Renders a donut SVG chart and stats grid showing daily study task completion, pending counts, and total study time.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Pro: Conditionally renders either the DailyProgressChart or WeeklyProgressChart based on the viewType prop, wrapped in a labeled section.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Sub: Renders a small colored badge for a subject name, deriving the color class from a utility function based on subject name or an explicit color.
A searchable popover dropdown component for filtering study planner tasks by subject, displaying each subject with its task count and supporting selection/deselection.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Wee: A card component that renders a donut SVG chart and stats grid showing weekly study task progress, including completed/pending counts and total study time for completed tasks.
frontend/src/components/UserGuidelineDoc: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query mutations and queries for backend interactions including study planner task management, feature requests, conversation saving, and frontend-only assignment generation.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSort.t: A hook that persists and restores the study planner sort mode ('default' or 'dateTime') in localStorage across sessions.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSubjec: A hook that independently persists and restores subject filter selections for the daily and weekly study planner views using localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerView.t: A hook that persists and restores the study planner view mode ('daily' or 'weekly') in localStorage, defaulting to 'weekly'.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (backgrounds, foregrounds, primary, sidebar, chart colors, etc.).
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
A feature-rich page for creating and formatting student assignments, supporting multi-language UI, title page fields, font/spacing settings, an editor with AI improvement, and PDF/Word/text download options.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: The landing page displaying a hero section and a grid of six tool cards (Assignment Format, Study Planner, Notes Cleaner, Leave Application, Resume Builder, Request a Feature) with navigation links.
A form-based page for generating student leave application letters with configurable recipient, date range, reason, language, and duration, with copy and PDF download functionality.
frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx: A two-panel page where students paste rough notes and receive cleaned, formatted output with options for bullet conversion, definition style, and heading detection, plus copy and text download actions.
frontend/src/pages/RequestFeaturePage.ts: A simple form page that lets students submit feature requests (with an optional email) via a mutation hook, storing requests for review.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeBuilderPage.tsx: A React page component that provides a form-based resume/CV builder for students and freshers, allowing input of personal info, education, skills, and projects, then generating and copying a formatted plain-text resume.
frontend/src/pages/StudyPlannerPage.tsx: A React page component for a study planner that supports adding, toggling, and deleting tasks with subject, priority, date, and duration fields, with both authenticated (backend) and guest (local storage) modes, plus sorting, filtering, and PDF/TXT export.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationDateF: Utility functions for formatting single dates, date ranges, and leave durations into human-readable strings, and calculating the number of days between two dates.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationLette: Defines types, translations for 20+ languages, and a template generator for school leave application letters, supporting multiple recipient types, durations, reasons, and RTL language detection.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationPdfEx: Opens a print window with a styled A4 HTML page containing the leave application letter content, selecting appropriate fonts per language and handling RTL layout, then triggers the browser print dialog for PDF export.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationReaso: Defines the available leave reason options (sick, family, personal, emergency, other) with labels and pre-written sentences, and provides a helper to retrieve the appropriate reason sentence.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerBulletSty: Defines bullet style types and provides helper functions to get the bullet prefix string and current active style, currently locked to dash style for Module 01.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerFormat.ts: Provides text formatting utilities for the Notes Cleaner feature, including auto-detecting headings, applying definition-style formatting, and splitting text into sentences per line.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerTxtDownlo: Provides a `downloadNotesAsTxt` function that generates a plain-text file from cleaned notes content, auto-generating a filename from the first word and current date or using a custom name if provided.
Exports `parseDurationToMinutes` and `formatMinutesToDuration` utilities for converting between duration strings (e.g., '1.5 hours') and total minutes.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerGuestStor: Manages guest-mode Study Planner tasks in localStorage, providing CRUD operations (add, toggle completion, delete, clear) and a load function that strips legacy fields.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerPdfExport: Exports `exportTasksToPdf` which generates a formatted HTML document from Study Planner tasks and opens it in a new window to trigger the browser's print-to-PDF dialog.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerSort.ts: Provides deterministic sorting for Study Planner tasks with two modes: default (by task ID) and dateTime (chronological by date/time, tasks without dates sorted last).
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTaskDateT: Utility functions for converting HTML date/time inputs to backend-compatible types and formatting task date/time values for display, handling both bigint (backend) and number (guest) representations.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTxtExport: Exports `exportTasksToTxt` which serializes Study Planner tasks into a Notepad-friendly plain-text file with a header, summary counts, and per-task details, then triggers a download.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerWeek.ts: Provides date utilities for the Study Planner's weekly view, including normalizing bigint/number task dates, computing the current week's Monday–Sunday bounds, and checking/indexing dates within the current week.
frontend/src/utils/subjectColorMapping.t: Provides a centralized mapping of subject names to color names and exports utility functions to retrieve Tailwind CSS badge and indicator bar color classes for a given subject, with optional persisted color override.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers for persisting values in sessionStorage and cleaning sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that sets up dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended border radius, box shadow, accordion keyframe animations, and registers the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the versioned project state for a leave letter generator app, recording its architecture (3-column CSS grid input form), known issues, and a list of implemented features with their requirements.
unknown.txt: Describes the feature set and UI/UX specifications for a student assignment tool, including an editor with download options, citation helper, teacher checklist, AI improvement button, and an embedded 'Student Sathi Assistant' chatbot fixed to the bottom-right corner.
